name: Crushes & Curses
source:
As a novice mage cursed with lost memories, you can’t remember how to wield your magic. In search of answers, you find yourself at Tara’s Tavern.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你是一名初学魔法的法师，受了诅咒，丢了记忆，连自己的魔法该怎么用都忘了。为寻找答案，你来到了塔拉的酒馆。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
